ab.paired_record: ctx['enhance_paired'] + extra['enhance_paired'] carry control/treatment + both funding readings

decision_record.calculation: Fixture (24x 4h ADA bars, breakout at signal bar): funding -0.001 at signal, +0.002 settled before entry close -> control enters qty 16650 (full cash), treatment refuses with paired record funding_at_signal=-0.001/funding_at_entry=+0.002; with entry funding still -0.003 treatment enters the identical qty 16650 (no size distortion).
decision_record.comparison: Baseline reads funding at the SIGNAL bar close (known_funding_rate at signal_close), 4h before the entry bar completes. Comparator: same bars/funding tape, funding re-read at the entry-bar close; entries proceed only while the freshest eligible receipt is still < 0.
decision_record.experiment: tests/test_harden_edge_batch11_blockers.py TestSqueezeAdaFundingRevalidation: flip refuses, still-negative enters unchanged, switch OFF restores the signal-time entry. Rejection rule: any refusal when the entry-bar funding is unobserved-but-signal-valid AND negative at entry, or any qty change when funding stays negative. Note: the 300s entry-window leak for this sleeve was already cured in-tree by edge batch 1 (ENH-ABS-WINDOW-20261024, window extended to the 3600s cadence); this is the next binding leak.
decision_record.mechanism: Perception (stale defining input): the strategy's defining condition is checked on a 4h-old observation and never revalidated at the moment full cash is deployed.
decision_record.transfer: The negative-funding squeeze's surplus is positioning: shorts paying funding into a breakout. If funding has normalized by the entry bar, the positioning premise — the scarce information — is gone.

disposition: ENHANCED: entry-bar funding revalidation (funding must still be < 0 at entry)
